items.raw_excerpt: A new service is bringing a doctor closer to First Nation communities, helping break down barriers to health care and enabling patients like Melanie Kahmahkotayo to get help for conditions like diabetes. But providers say access is only part of the challenge, with racism and mistrust also affecting Indigenous patients' experiences.
items.summary_en: A new service brings a doctor to First Nation communities in Saskatchewan. Patients like Melanie Kahmahkotayo can now get help for diabetes and other conditions. Providers say access is only half the challenge, because racism and mistrust still affect care.
items.summary_ko: 새로운 서비스가 서스캐처원의 퍼스트 네이션 마을에 의사를 데려옵니다. 멜라니 카마코타요 같은 환자는 이제 당뇨병 같은 질환에 도움을 받을 수 있습니다. 하지만 의료진은 접근성이 해결의 절반일 뿐이라고 말합니다. 인종 차별과 불신이 원주민 환자의 경험에 여전히 영향을 미치기 때문입니다.
items.title_en: She waited 17 years for a family doctor. A new partnership brought one to her community
items.title_ko: 17년 동안 가정의가 없었던 그녀… 새 협력으로 마을에 가정의가 생기다

items.raw_excerpt: From new murals and botanical sculptures to a lunar eclipse and aura farming, see what’s happening in San Miguel de Allende.
items.summary_en: A local roundup of things to see and do in San Miguel de Allende. New murals and botanical sculptures are now on display. A lunar eclipse and aura farming sessions are also part of the events.

items.raw_excerpt: Amid the storm kicked up by the passage of the Karnataka Government Parks (Preservation) Act Amendment Bill, 2026, data from the Horticulture Department show that it manages only 28 parks and botanical gardens spread across 1,287 acres in Karnataka
items.summary_en: Karnataka's horticulture department manages only 28 parks and gardens across 1,287 acres. This data came out during a debate over a new parks bill.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카주의 원예부가 관리하는 공원과 식물원은 1,287에이커에 걸쳐 28곳뿐이라는 데이터가 나왔습니다. 이 수치는 새 공원 법안을 둘러싼 논쟁 속에서 공개됐습니다.
items.title_original: Amid parks Bill row, data shows that Karnataka manages only 28 major parks, gardens

items.raw_excerpt: Andri Snær Magnason and Sara Dosa discuss Time and Water after a Friday screening at Bíó Paradís — a documentary about family memory and disappearing glaciers.
items.summary_en: Andri Snær Magnason and Sara Dosa will talk about their documentary Time and Water after a Friday screening at Bíó Paradís in Reykjavík. The film tells the story of family memory and melting glaciers.

items.raw_excerpt: A sesame cooking oil maker in Chiayi City was ordered to halt operations on Wednesday after excessive levels of benzo[a]pyrene (BaP), a known carcinogen, were detected in its products, the city's Public Health Bureau said.
items.summary_en: A sesame cooking oil maker in Chiayi City was ordered to halt operations. Health officials found high levels of a known carcinogen in its products.

items.raw_excerpt: Trecho de 1,68 km recebe nova camada de asfalto entre a Rua Sodrelândia e o terminal de ônibus do bairro A Prefeitura do Recife segue avançando com os serviços de recuperação da malha viária da cidade. Na noite desta terça-feira (25), o prefeito Victor Marques acompanhou o andamento do recapeamento da Avenida Aníbal Benévolo, em […]
items.summary_en: The city of Recife put a new layer of asphalt on a 1.68 km stretch of Avenida Anibal Benevolo. The work covered the road from Rua Sodrelandia to the neighborhood bus terminal. Mayor Victor Marques checked the progress on Tuesday night. The project cost 1.74 million reais.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria may be heading towards September, but summer isn’t quite finished yet. With another spell of temperatures above 30C forecast for the final days of August, this is a good moment for a word describing that in-between stretch: Spätsommer.
items.summary_en: Austria is heading towards September, but summer is not quite finished yet. Another spell of temperatures above 30C is forecast for the final days of August. It is a good moment to learn the word Spätsommer, which describes that in-between stretch.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아는 9월을 향해 가고 있지만 여름은 아직 끝나지 않았습니다. 8월 마지막 날에는 또다시 30도가 넘는 기온이 예보되어 있습니다. 여름과 가을 사이의 어중간한 시기를 일컫는 말인 '슈페트조머'를 배워 두기 좋은 때입니다.
items.title_en: German Word of the Day: Spätsommer
